episode_title: Army Explosives Detonation In Iowa, Abrego Garcia Leaves The US, Congress And Nvidia
script_en: Army Explosives Detonation In Iowa, Abrego Garcia Leaves The US, Congress And Nvidia.
The Army is set to destroy thousands of pounds of unstable explosives in Iowa after several delays, as residents prepare for the potential spread of toxic lead dust.
Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the Salvadoran immigrant who was mistakenly deported and brought back to the U.S., has voluntarily left the country after a nearly two-year legal battle.
Lawmakers in both parties are pressing for answers about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s national security scandal and considering tighter restrictions on chip sales to China.
